summary: AliceBlue drops the market socket: the relay creates a socket session again, connects, logs in and, once AliceBlue answers, the feed subscribes again; the new tk snapshot streams as before.

notes: The desktop starts each connection without the previous snapshots (brokers/aliceblue/streaming.rs on_connected); the web keeps them (audit appendix item 11). AliceBlue answers the new subscribe with a full tk, so the frames agree.

deviations.reason: The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft as ltt in epoch seconds, an integer since web #2473 (aliceblue_adapter.py `_feed_time`, `_quote_fields`); the docs key ltt is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md).
